postconditions.probe:
p1=$(git rev-parse HEAD^1) || exit 1
p2=$(git rev-parse HEAD^2) || exit 1
base=$(git merge-base "$p1" "$p2") || exit 1
common=$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" "$p1" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" "$p2" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
count=$(printf '%s\n' "$common" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)
[ "$count" -eq 1 ] || exit 1
file=$(printf '%s\n' "$common" | sed '/^$/d' | head -n1)

items() {
  git show "$1:$file" | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"[[:space:]]*,?[[:space:]]*$' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//' | sort -u
}

local_items=$(items "$p1")
upstream_items=$(items "$p2")
base_items=$(items "$base")
head_items=$(items HEAD)

upstream_new=$(comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$upstream_items") <(printf '%s\n' "$base_items") | sed '/^$/d')
expected=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$local_items" "$upstream_new" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u)
actual=$(printf '%s\n' "$head_items" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u)
[ "$expected" = "$actual" ] || exit 1

kv() {
  git show "$1:$file" | awk -F= '
    /^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[[:space:]]*=/ {
      key=$1; sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", key); sub(/[[:space:]]*$/, "", key);
      val=$2; sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", val); sub(/[[:space:]]*$/, "", val);
      if (val != "[" && val != "{" && val != "(") print key "=" val;
    }' | sort
}

upstream_kv=$(kv "$p2")
base_kv=$(kv "$base")
head_kv=$(kv HEAD)

while IFS='=' read -r key val; do
  [ -z "$key" ] && continue
  base_val=$(printf '%s\n' "$base_kv" | grep -E "^${key//./\\.}=" | head -n1 | cut -d= -f2-)
  if [ -n "$base_val" ] && [ "$base_val" != "$val" ]; then
    head_val=$(printf '%s\n' "$head_kv" | grep -E "^${key//./\\.}=" | head -n1 | cut -d= -f2-)
    [ "$head_val" = "$val" ] || exit 1
  fi
done <<< "$upstream_kv"

exit 0
